records.text: The marketing will be focused towards the youth market.
They discussed including a touch-based graphical user interface but noted that it was unnecessary and costly.
The fruits and vegetables trend will be incorporated into the design by including fruit colors along with the company colors.
The Marketing Expert made a presentation of the needs and the desires of the consumer and emphasized simplicity as one of the most desired features.
The User Interface Designer will work on the interface and the Industrial Designer will work on the look and feel of the device.
The remote will feature a spongy material.
The Project Manager instructed the User Interface Designer and the Industrial Designer to construct the prototype and the Marketing Expert to work on the prototype evaluation.
The Project Manager will post the discussion notes and the meeting's minutes to be available to all the participants.
The group decided that the final cost of the prototype was low enough that they could continue with the current prototype and still meet the profit goals.
The group also discussed energy source options and chips.
The User Interface Designer discussed the look of the remote with the group.
The company logo will appear in a brief flash in the boot-up screen of the device.
The Industrial Designer gave his presentation on the basic components of a remote control device, and advised the group to use plastic for the casing material instead of metal.
The Project Manager summarized the accomplishments of the meeting.
The group discussed how the menu function would be programmed.
The Project Manager instructed the User Interface Designer and the Industrial Designer to construct the prototype.
The Project Manager went over new requirements for the project: that the device was solely to control television, and that there would not be a teletext component.
The group also decided that the design of the prototype was satisfactory and met enough of the users' requirements to be able to be marketed.
The group then talked about the casing of the device, and decided that there would be a changeable outer casing.
The Project Manager reviewed the minutes from the previous meeting.
The Industrial Designer gave her presentation on components and discussed which would have to be custom-made and which were standard.
They discussed using the menu function on the television instead.

The group discussed in more detail the features that will be added to the device: the possible applications of voice recognition, the touch screen menu interface, faceplates, and the look of the company logo.
There was a lack of information on the cost of several components.
The remote will have a locating device that operates either through voice recognition or through paging.
She discussed the current fruits and vegetables trend and the trend toward softer, spongier materials.
The remote will feature a changeable outer casing.
The Project Manager presented the final cost of the remote with the finalized list of components.
The Marketing Expert presented current trends in the market and in fashion.
The group decided that the prototype met enough of these goals to be able to market the product.
The Marketing Expert presented an evaluation of the prototype to the group.
She also discussed the various materials and chips available.
The final cost was under the alotted budget; the Project Manager announced that the project could then continue with the current prototype.
The group evaluated the prototype based on the requirements of users presented in the first meetings.
The User Interface Designer presented the technical functions of remote controls and compared the interfaces of two existing remote control products.
The group wanted to include a changeable outer casing but could not decide whether the spongy or the hard plastic component should be the removable casing.
The group had problems with sacrificing popular features in order to stay within the project budget.
The prototype was presented and the group discussed the look of the prototype.
The group decided to keep the touch screen interface, and to keep the main interface simple.
The group decided to use plastic as their casing material instead of metal.
Some part of the casing will be made of a spongy material.
The Marketing Expert will prepare a prototype evaluation.
They discussed including fruit colors in addition to the company colors.
